edits.old: local nlegs=9 npass=0 nfail=0 nsetup=0 st
edits.new:
local nlegs=9 npass=0 nfail=0 nsetup=0 st
  if (( st_mado != 0 )); then st_roundgate=$st_sourcescheck; fi

rationale: An error-path copy and paste overwrites the round-gate status from sources-check after the mado leg fails, losing a second failing leg.
